## Context
Research on lead-unpleasing-kitten (7da8-9d47-9604-4257) measured 57.707s (68.4%) savings across three matched immutable-fixture scan-reuse cohorts (Python-oracle x5, mixed coverage x5, Engine-B JS x3), but the operator ratified (2026-08-22) implementing ONLY call-local validation dedup (landed as Gerrit change 2130 / commit 8481a057b696). Cross-worker scan-result reuse was explicitly deferred to this ticket as an unresolved DESIGN QUESTION, not an implementation task.

## The caching-boundary design question
- pytest-xdist fixtures are worker-local under `-n 3 --dist worksteal`; ordinary module/session fixture scope CANNOT share an expensive scan result across workers. Realizing the measured savings requires one of: consolidating assertions into fewer nodes (moves coverage location), an explicit cross-process immutable artifact/cache, or a distribution change.
- STALE-RESULT RISK: any cache keyed on a fixture tree must prove the tree is immutable for the cache lifetime. If the tree (or detector registry, or tool version) changes mid-run, a reused result silently tests the wrong state. A sound design needs a content-addressed key (tree hash + detector-source hash + binary version) or a guaranteed-immutable fixture contract, plus invalidation semantics.
- Contractual constraints from shockproof-twill-porpoise (tool presence/absence + explicit coverage accounting) and crushable-choosable-llama (real scanner/process integration retained): at least one real invocation per external boundary and environment state must survive any reuse design.
- Residual gaps recorded on the parent: no direct exact-defect tests yet for malformed OpenGrep SARIF / ast-grep JSON / metric JSON; broad invocation removal must not be approved until those are pinned.

## Acceptance criteria (for whoever picks this up)
- [ ] A written design choosing and justifying a caching boundary (node consolidation vs cross-process artifact cache vs distribution change), with an explicit staleness/invalidation story.
- [ ] The design preserves every unique real analyzer boundary and both tool-present/tool-absent states per the parent's fault/equivalence matrix.
- [ ] Operator approval before any test-boundary or coverage-location change.
compiled_state.title: Design caching boundary for cross-worker grounding scan-result reuse
